## Validation Rules Captured By The Schema

- The root object has `additionalProperties: false`; unknown top-level fields are rejected.
- Most normalized declaration shapes also set `additionalProperties: false`; `profile_like`, `asset`, `validate`, `repair_policy_spec`, `patch`, and a few intent-bearing maps intentionally allow extension fields.
- `kind` is limited to `hard_surface_prop`, `env_module`, and `mechanical_assembly`.
- Unit literals normalize to `{type, value, unit}` objects whose `unit` value is one of the grammar-supported unit suffixes.
- Rule weights and space objective weights must be positive when present.
- Top-level repair policies and validate repair specs require non-negative `max_rounds` when the field is present.
